year.label: Early 1990s Ferrari F40 LM competition specification

identity.real_world_identity_notes: The official Assetto Corsa EVO release identifies this content as the Ferrari F40 LM, a competition development of the F40 for IMSA-style racing in the early 1990s. The real car was a limited Michelotto/Ferrari-sanctioned race specification rather than the standard road F40. Reviewed sources establish the F40 LM family and its five-speed race transmission with hydraulic multi-plate clutch, but not one chassis number or one exact build year. The control baseline therefore remains conservative where a source does not describe the installed variant or driving technique.

wheel_rim.notes: Exact real-car wheel details were not established by the reviewed sources.

KUNOS's official AC EVO release names the exact F40 LM simulator content and its competition purpose. Independent secondary technical references identify the Michelotto F40 LM family, early-1990s production period, five-speed manual transmission, and triple-plate hydraulic clutch. The year is deliberately represented as a period label because the observation does not identify a chassis or exact build year.

claims.basis: KUNOS's official AC EVO release names the exact F40 LM simulator content and its competition purpose. Independent secondary technical references identify the Michelotto F40 LM family, early-1990s production period, five-speed manual transmission, and triple-plate hydraulic clutch. The year is deliberately represented as a period label because the observation does not identify a chassis or exact build year.

The F40 LM technical references independently identify a five-speed manual transmission, with Mitorosso listing five forward gears plus reverse.
